text: 【Abstract】Objective Statistical analysis of the labeling of children's drug use and drug interaction in the instructions of Chinese patent medicines in the outpatient pharmacy of our hospital， and make recommendations. Methods Fifty-eight Specifications of Chinese patent medicines currently in use in the outpatient pharmacy of our hospital were collected. The labeling of children's medication， precautions for children， dosage and drug interaction in drug instructions were counted. And according to oral， topical， injection and other contents of the summary analysis. Results Of the 58 drug instructions， 50 were taken orally， 6 were for external use and 2 were for injection. The labeling rates of oral drugs for children， precautions for children， dosage for children （including children's discretion） and drug interaction were 14.00%， 46.00%， 22.00% and 34.00% respectively. The labeling rates of drugs for external use were 33.33%， 33.33%， 0.00% and 16.67% respectively. The labeling rates of injectable drugs were 50.00%， 50.00%， 0.00%，0.00%. There were 11 （18.96%） with definite dosage for children's use. Usage： 7 （12.07%） were related to children. Children were reminded to use them under the supervision of doctors/adults in 12 cases （20.69%）. Nine （15.51%） of the children's drug use were not clear and their safety had not yet been established. One of them （1.72%） suggested that children should be cautious and forbidden to use. 32 （55.17%） did not include any indication of medication for children. 22 （37.93%） were kept out of reach of children. 21 （63.79%） without a notice to children. Conclusion The low labeling rate of children's usage and dosage in the instructions of Chinese patent medicines in our hospital， the lack of drug interaction and contraindication， the unclear content of the label of children's medication makes it difficult for patients to understand. It is suggested that the contents of children's medication， drug interactions and taboos should be marked in detail， and the revision of drug instructions should be standardized to improve the safety， effectiveness and guidance of Chinese patent medicine instructions， so as to ensure the safe and rational drug use in children.儿童由于处于生长发育的过程当中，肝脏和肾脏等其他脏器相对于成人是比较薄弱的，选择用药时需要考虑对肝脏和肾脏的影响，儿童用药不是成人的缩小版，需根据患儿的具体病情、病因以及症状来对症用药；
